name: Dixit
description:
Dixit MCP connects Claude directly to Dixit Platform’s structured public affairs and institutional intelligence.

It gives your AI assistant access to reliable French and European political, legislative and regulatory data, including legislative procedures, amendments, parliamentary questions, debates, elected officials, institutional documents and stakeholder information.

Instead of relying only on what the model already knows, users can ask questions in natural language and have the assistant search Dixit’s up-to-date institutional data to produce more accurate, contextual and source-grounded answers.

The connector is designed for public affairs professionals who want to research policy developments, understand legislative activity, identify relevant policymakers and stakeholders, analyse institutional signals, and turn public affairs intelligence into actionable outputs without leaving their AI assistant.

Dixit MCP provides read-only access to Dixit data. Results include links back to the underlying records and sources, allowing users to verify information and continue their analysis directly in Dixit Platform.

In short, Dixit MCP combines the reasoning capabilities of modern AI assistants with the structured, specialised and continuously updated institutional data of Dixit Platform.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Dixit to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Dixit to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.dixitplatform.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Dixit MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Dixit provides these MCP tools: get_entity, list_alerts, list_entities_by_organ, list_entities_by_person, list_entities_by_procedure, list_entities_by_stakeholder, list_entities_from_alert, and search_entities.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Dixit?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Dixit in legal on the Manufact MCP catalog include GVRN Company Incorporation MCP, Alizé, Ansvar AI, Casepoint, and CiteLaw.
Dixit requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Dixit is developed by Dixit Platform. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
